### Checklist

- [ ] One site per pull request, and it's a site a lot of people use. Not a
      personal site, an intranet host or a parked domain.
- [ ] The domain is bare and lowercase: no `https://`, no `www.`, no path.
- [ ] I searched the open and closed pull requests and nobody else has one for
      this domain. If there's a stale one, I linked it above.
- [ ] The `.icns` has 16, 32, 128, 256 and 512pt at both 1x and 2x.
- [ ] Square, transparent, nothing upscaled, no rounded-rect plate or shadow
      baked in. The dock adds its own.
- [ ] It still reads clearly at 32px.
- [ ] The `.car`, if there is one, came out of `actool`.
- [ ] It's the site's own mark and I'm allowed to use it.
